description: Controls Silver staging table creation and execution ordering before downstream Silver DBT processing.

tables.description: Builds the BedServiceActivity Silver staging table.
tables.query: WITH CombinedBedStatus AS ( SELECT CONCAT(CAST(bs.BedOrgEntSys AS STRING), '_', CAST(bs.ServSeq AS STRING)) AS BedServiceId, bs.BedOrgEntSys AS BedId, bs.ServSeq, s.ServiceID AS ServiceId, TO_DATE(bs.EffectiveDate) AS StatusStartDate, TO_DATE(bs.InactiveDate) AS StatusEndDate, EXPLODE(SEQUENCE(TO_DATE(bs.EffectiveDate), COALESCE(TO_DATE(bs.InactiveDate), CURRENT_DATE()), INTERVAL 1 DAY)) AS BedStatusDate, 'Active' AS BedStatus, CAST(NULL AS STRING) AS ReasonCode, 2 AS StatusPriority FROM bronze_lh.Netsmart.bedservice bs INNER JOIN bronze_lh.Netsmart.services s ON bs.ServiceSys = s.ServiceSys WHERE TO_DATE(bs.EffectiveDate) <= COALESCE(TO_DATE(bs.InactiveDate), CURRENT_DATE()) UNION ALL SELECT CONCAT(CAST(o.OrgEntSys AS STRING), '_', CAST(bs.ServSeq AS STRING)) AS BedServiceId, o.OrgEntSys AS BedId, bs.ServSeq, s.ServiceID AS ServiceId, TO_DATE(o.StartDate) AS StatusStartDate, TO_DATE(o.EndDate) AS StatusEndDate, EXPLODE(SEQUENCE(TO_DATE(o.StartDate), COALESCE(TO_DATE(o.EndDate), CURRENT_DATE()), INTERVAL 1 DAY)) AS BedStatusDate, 'InActive' AS BedStatus, o.ReasonTypeCode AS ReasonCode, 1 AS StatusPriority FROM bronze_lh.Netsmart.orginactive o INNER JOIN bronze_lh.Netsmart.bedservice bs ON o.OrgEntSys = bs.BedOrgEntSys AND TO_DATE(o.StartDate) BETWEEN TO_DATE(bs.EffectiveDate) AND COALESCE(TO_DATE(bs.InactiveDate), CURRENT_DATE()) INNER JOIN bronze_lh.Netsmart.services s ON bs.ServiceSys = s.ServiceSys WHERE TO_DATE(o.StartDate) <= COALESCE(TO_DATE(o.EndDate), CURRENT_DATE()) ), PrioritizedBedStatus AS ( SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY BedId, BedStatusDate ORDER BY StatusPriority) AS RowNumber FROM CombinedBedStatus ), BedServiceActivity AS ( SELECT BedServiceId, BedId, ServiceId, BedStatusDate AS BedActivityStatusDate, BedStatus, ReasonCode FROM PrioritizedBedStatus WHERE RowNumber = 1 ), BedMapping AS ( SELECT DISTINCT TRIM(nfs.ServiceID) AS ServiceID, s.ServiceSys, nfs.Facility, nfs.LevelOfCare, nfs.CategoryClassification, bs.BedOrgEntSys AS BedId, UPPER(SPLIT(TRIM(nfs.Facility), ' ')[0]) AS ShortFacility, nfs.DualOccupancy, UPPER(TRIM(nfs.Status)) AS Status FROM bronze_lh.ReferenceData.newfacilityservices nfs INNER JOIN bronze_lh.Netsmart.services s ON UPPER(TRIM(s.ServiceID)) = UPPER(TRIM(nfs.ServiceID)) INNER JOIN bronze_lh.Netsmart.bedservice bs ON bs.ServiceSys = s.ServiceSys WHERE bs.InactiveDate IS NULL ), Beds AS ( SELECT DISTINCT bm.Facility, bm.CategoryClassification AS LevelOfCare, o.NameID4 AS Unit, o.NameID3 AS Floor_Hall, o.NameID2 AS RoomNumber, o.NameID1 AS BedName, bm.BedId, bm.ServiceID, bm.DualOccupancy FROM BedMapping bm INNER JOIN bronze_lh.Netsmart.organizations o ON bm.BedId = o.EntSys1 AND bm.ShortFacility = UPPER(SPLIT(TRIM(o.NameID5), ' ')[0]) WHERE bm.Status = 'ACTIVE' ) SELECT b.Facility, b.LevelOfCare, b.Unit, b.Floor_Hall AS Floor, b.RoomNumber AS Room, bsa.ServiceId, b.BedName,bsa.BedId, bsa.BedActivityStatusDate, bsa.BedStatus, bsa.ReasonCode FROM BedServiceActivity bsa INNER JOIN Beds b ON b.BedId = bsa.BedId WHERE bsa.BedStatus <> 'InActive' AND bsa.BedActivityStatusDate >= TO_DATE('2022-01-01')

tables.description: Builds the DailyCensus Silver staging table.
tables.query: WITH EpsCensusTransExploded AS ( SELECT t.EpsCensusTranSys, t.EpisodeSys, t.CensSeq, t.TransType AS ActionCode, t.LeaveType, t.PlanSys AS LeavePlanSys, EXPLODE( SEQUENCE( TO_DATE(t.TransDateTime), COALESCE( DATE_SUB(TO_DATE(t.TransEndDate), 1), CURRENT_DATE() ), INTERVAL 1 DAY ) ) AS CensusDate, CAST(t.TransDateTime AS TIMESTAMP) AS TransDateTime, CAST( COALESCE( DATE_SUB(TO_DATE(t.TransEndDate), 1), CURRENT_DATE() ) AS TIMESTAMP ) AS TransEndDate, t.BedSys, t.ReturningType, t.LeaveToType, t.LeaveToEntSys, t.IsBedSwap, t.SYS_CHANGE_OPERATION, t.RecordIngestedBy, CAST(t.RecordIngestedOn AS TIMESTAMP) AS RecordIngestedOn, t.RecordModifiedBy, CAST(t.RecordModifiedOn AS TIMESTAMP) AS RecordModifiedOn, t.RecordStatus FROM bronze_lh.Netsmart.epscensustrans t WHERE t.TransType NOT IN ('AD', 'TR', 'DI') AND t.TransDateTime IS NOT NULL AND COALESCE( DATE_SUB(TO_DATE(t.TransEndDate), 1), CURRENT_DATE() ) >= TO_DATE(t.TransDateTime) ), CoreCensusRanked AS ( SELECT t.EntitySys, t.EpisodeSys, t.DisplayName, t.InternalID, TO_DATE(t.AdmissionDate) AS AdmissionDate, TO_DATE(t.DischargeDate) AS DischargeDate, CAST(t.TransDateTime AS TIMESTAMP) AS TransDateTime, CAST(t.BeginBed AS TIMESTAMP) AS BeginBed, CAST(t.EndBed AS TIMESTAMP) AS EndBed, TO_DATE(t.BeginBed) AS BeginBedDate, COALESCE( DATE_SUB(TO_DATE(t.EndBed), 1), CURRENT_DATE() ) AS EndBedDate, t.EpsPlanSys, t.Name5, t.Ent1 AS BedId, t.Ent2 AS RoomId, t.Ent3 AS FloorId, t.Ent4 AS UnitId, t.Ent5 AS FacilityId, t.Ent6 AS FacilityCode, t.SYS_CHANGE_OPERATION, t.RecordIngestedBy, CAST(t.RecordIngestedOn AS TIMESTAMP) AS RecordIngestedOn, t.RecordModifiedBy, CAST(t.RecordModifiedOn AS TIMESTAMP) AS RecordModifiedOn, t.RecordStatus, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY t.EpisodeSys, TO_DATE(t.BeginBed), TO_DATE(t.EndBed) ORDER BY t.TrfDateCreated DESC ) AS RowNumber FROM bronze_lh.Netsmart.vwcorecensus t WHERE t.Lev1 = 90 ), CoreCensusWithNextBed AS ( SELECT c.*, LEAD(c.BeginBedDate) OVER ( PARTITION BY c.EpisodeSys ORDER BY c.BeginBed ) AS NextBeginBedDate FROM CoreCensusRanked c WHERE c.RowNumber = 1 ), CoreCensusRanges AS ( SELECT c.*, CASE WHEN c.EndBedDate = c.NextBeginBedDate THEN DATE_SUB(c.EndBedDate, 1) ELSE c.EndBedDate END AS AdjustedEndBedDate FROM CoreCensusWithNextBed c ), CoreCensusExploded AS ( SELECT c.EntitySys, c.EpisodeSys, c.DisplayName, c.InternalID, c.AdmissionDate, c.DischargeDate, c.TransDateTime, exploded_dates.CensusDate, c.BeginBed, c.EndBed, CASE WHEN c.AdmissionDate = exploded_dates.CensusDate THEN 'AD' WHEN c.DischargeDate = exploded_dates.CensusDate THEN 'DI' WHEN c.TransDateTime BETWEEN c.BeginBed AND COALESCE(c.EndBed, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP()) THEN 'TR' ELSE NULL END AS ActionCode, c.EpsPlanSys, c.Name5, c.BedId, c.RoomId, c.FloorId, c.UnitId, c.FacilityId, c.FacilityCode, c.SYS_CHANGE_OPERATION, c.RecordIngestedBy, c.RecordIngestedOn, c.RecordModifiedBy, c.RecordModifiedOn, c.RecordStatus FROM CoreCensusRanges c LATERAL VIEW EXPLODE( SEQUENCE( c.BeginBedDate, c.AdjustedEndBedDate, INTERVAL 1 DAY ) ) exploded_dates AS CensusDate WHERE c.BeginBedDate IS NOT NULL AND c.AdjustedEndBedDate IS NOT NULL AND c.BeginBedDate <= c.AdjustedEndBedDate ), CombinedCensus AS ( SELECT ct.EpisodeSys, c.EntitySys, c.DisplayName, c.CensusDate, c.FacilityCode, c.FacilityId, c.UnitId, c.FloorId, c.RoomId, c.BedId, c.Name5, ct.ActionCode, c.SYS_CHANGE_OPERATION, c.RecordIngestedBy, c.RecordIngestedOn, c.RecordModifiedBy, c.RecordModifiedOn, c.RecordStatus FROM EpsCensusTransExploded ct INNER JOIN CoreCensusExploded c ON ct.EpisodeSys = c.EpisodeSys AND ct.CensusDate = c.CensusDate WHERE ct.ActionCode = 'LV' UNION SELECT c.EpisodeSys, c.EntitySys, c.DisplayName, c.CensusDate, c.FacilityCode, c.FacilityId, c.UnitId, c.FloorId, c.RoomId, c.BedId, c.Name5, c.ActionCode, c.SYS_CHANGE_OPERATION, c.RecordIngestedBy, c.RecordIngestedOn, c.RecordModifiedBy, c.RecordModifiedOn, c.RecordStatus FROM CoreCensusExploded c ), DeduplicatedCensus AS ( SELECT c.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY c.EpisodeSys, c.CensusDate ORDER BY CASE WHEN c.ActionCode IS NOT NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END ) AS RowNumber FROM CombinedCensus c ), LeaveDetails AS ( SELECT EpisodeSys, CensusDate, LeaveType, LeavePlanSys FROM ( SELECT e.EpisodeSys, e.CensusDate, e.LeaveType, e.LeavePlanSys, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY e.EpisodeSys, e.CensusDate ORDER BY CASE WHEN e.LeavePlanSys IS NOT NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, e.TransDateTime DESC, e.EpsCensusTranSys DESC ) AS RowNumber FROM EpsCensusTransExploded e WHERE e.ActionCode = 'LV' ) leave_rows WHERE RowNumber = 1 ), PrimaryBillingSequence AS ( SELECT DISTINCT EpisodeSys, PlanSys, TO_DATE(EffBegDate) AS EffectiveStartDate, TO_DATE( COALESCE(EffEndDate, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP()) ) AS EffectiveEndDate FROM bronze_lh.Netsmart.epsbillsequence WHERE BillOrder = 1 ), ServiceCommonCode AS ( SELECT DISTINCT ServiceSys, TRIM(ServiceID) AS ServiceId FROM bronze_lh.Netsmart.services WHERE ServiceSys IS NOT NULL ), FinalDailyCensus AS ( SELECT d.EpisodeSys, d.EntitySys, d.DisplayName, d.CensusDate, d.FacilityCode, d.FacilityId, d.UnitId, d.FloorId, d.RoomId, d.BedId, service.ServiceId, COALESCE( leave.LeavePlanSys, billing.PlanSys ) AS PlanSys, leave.LeaveType, CASE WHEN payer.PayerTypeCode IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CONCAT_WS( '_', ELEMENT_AT( SPLIT(TRIM(d.Name5), ' '), -1 ), payer.PayerTypeCode ) END AS PayerType, d.SYS_CHANGE_OPERATION, d.RecordIngestedBy, d.RecordIngestedOn, d.RecordModifiedBy, d.RecordModifiedOn, d.RecordStatus FROM DeduplicatedCensus d INNER JOIN bronze_lh.Netsmart.bedservice bs ON bs.BedOrgEntSys = d.BedId AND d.CensusDate >= TO_DATE(bs.EffectiveDate) AND d.CensusDate < COALESCE( TO_DATE(bs.InactiveDate), DATE '9999-12-31' ) INNER JOIN ServiceCommonCode service ON service.ServiceSys = bs.ServiceSys LEFT JOIN LeaveDetails leave ON leave.EpisodeSys = d.EpisodeSys AND leave.CensusDate = d.CensusDate LEFT JOIN PrimaryBillingSequence billing ON billing.EpisodeSys = d.EpisodeSys AND d.CensusDate >= billing.EffectiveStartDate AND d.CensusDate <= billing.EffectiveEndDate LEFT JOIN bronze_lh.Netsmart.vwpayersplans payer ON payer.PlanSys = COALESCE( leave.LeavePlanSys, billing.PlanSys ) WHERE d.RowNumber = 1 ), FinalDailyCensusDedup AS ( SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY EpisodeSys, EntitySys, DisplayName, CensusDate, FacilityCode, FacilityId, UnitId, FloorId, RoomId, BedId, ServiceId, PlanSys, COALESCE(LeaveType, 'NA'), COALESCE(PayerType, 'NA') ORDER BY RecordIngestedOn DESC, RecordModifiedOn DESC ) AS rn FROM FinalDailyCensus ) SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( ORDER BY EpisodeSys, EntitySys, CensusDate, FacilityId, UnitId, FloorId, RoomId, BedId, ServiceId, PlanSys, COALESCE(LeaveType, 'NA'), COALESCE(PayerType, 'NA') ) AS CensusId, EpisodeSys, EntitySys, DisplayName, CensusDate, FacilityCode, FacilityId, UnitId, FloorId, RoomId, BedId, ServiceId, PlanSys, LeaveType, PayerType, SYS_CHANGE_OPERATION, RecordIngestedBy, RecordIngestedOn, RecordModifiedBy, RecordModifiedOn, RecordStatus FROM FinalDailyCensusDedup WHERE rn = 1
